Runtime routing now requires an exact reviewed identityCast for the committed perspective and participants; otherwise it falls back to the correct character portrait instead of showing mismatched event footage.
Generated candidates rejected for wrong cast/card count, pseudo-UI or text, continuity reset, collage composition, or unrelated fallback are excluded from runtime integration.

R9 ledger repair registers the two legacy E01 clips already referenced by runtime code. Their hashes, H.264/yuv420p 480x854 encoding, 24fps rate, 5.041667-second duration and silent streams are verified; both remain provisional holds for node-contract and rights review.

R9B separately generated one replacement portrait candidate for Qince and one for Shaozheng under a CNY 5 repair cap, settling CNY 0.7917456 with zero paid retries.
